en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad Al Jowhary, from Al Husayn Bin Umar Bin Yazeed, from his father who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The dyeing with the black (dye) is amusing for the women, and an awe to the enemy’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhariy from al-Husayn ibn ‘Umar ibn Yazid from his father who has said the following:
“I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Applying black hair dye is entertaining for women and show one’s firmness to the enemy. 5 ”
